result.description: A fictional 27-inch e-ink drafting tablet built for storyboard artists and archival annotation teams. It uses a low-power monochrome panel, a pressure-sensitive stylus dock, and USB-C data/power input. The device emphasizes long-form note capture, page-based layouts, and daylight readability rather than gaming, storage, or server use. Includes an aluminum stand, palm rejection, and local document caching for up to 8,000 pages.
result.title: Nebula Quill 27Q Paper Tablet
